text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, after buying daily necessities at 
the shopping district, I was heading back—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby at the shopping district... 
When I asked about such a rare sight, she 
turned her gaze toward the auto repair 
shop just down the street—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
On our way back, my butler noticed an 
issue with the driving performance. A 
contracted garage happened to be nearby, 
so it is currently undergoing inspection.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"Since they said it would take a while, I 
was about to head home first, just as you 
approached from the opposite direction."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
We share the same destination, and we have 
matters to discuss. Therefore, I 
determined that utilizing our travel time 
would be the most efficient course of 
action.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Well then, let us be on our way.
choice_data_list: S-Sorry! Can you wait just a little bit?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the 
fun, fun lottery! Anyone and everyone, 
come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...The lottery.
choice_data_list:
I really wanted to do that before going 
home...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"I don't mind. It shouldn't take very long 
anyway."
choice_data_list: Want to give it a try too, Ruby?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I must decline.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With Daiichi Ruby watching over me, I spun 
the raffle wheel!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Congratulations.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Oho, look at you all thrilled! Makes me 
happy to see! Do you love hot springs that 
much?
choice_data_list: I thought it would be good for a refresh.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Oho, you look quite exhausted... Wait, 
that badge means you're a Trainer! And the 
young lady is a Tracen student...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha? Little lady, you're pretty harsh 
on this guy, aren't you? You shouldn't be 
like that, gotta show him some love.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you for your valuable feedback—
choice_data_list: She's such a kind girl, you know

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah... I see. Sorry for meddling! Have 
fun on your trip!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
—I believe describing it as "kind" would 
be inaccurate.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I'm referring to the assessment of me that 
you gave to the shopping district folks 
earlier.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to state beforehand that, in the 
first place, there was no need for you to 
be considerate toward me.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Even so, even if you were shielding them, 
wasn't the word 'kind' a bit unfitting?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Kind" was merely echoing what was said to 
him. What it really meant was that Daiichi 
Ruby had been treating him with more than 
enough care—
choice_data_list: I guess that means showing some respect.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I see.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"...Once the dates for the trip are 
decided, please let me know."
choice_data_list: No, I'm going to save it for later!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I am in no position to be carefree on a 
trip right now. Until I grow, get results, 
and feel satisfied with myself, I cannot 
accept any rewards.
choice_data_list:
I'll do my best until I can be just like 
Ruby!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"...There is absolutely no need for you to 
become like me."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
However... I think it is wonderful to keep 
striving until the day comes where you can 
be satisfied with yourself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, until the day comes when we can 
relax and soak in the hot springs at our 
leisure... the trip voucher was tucked 
away safely.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"This Salisbury steak is suuuper tasty! 
And really filling, too!"

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Wouldn't it be just the right amount if 
you shared it with the young lady with 
you?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Please, Trainer, eat all of it.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
...Mm, Ruby...? Wait, young lady, are you 
from the 'Illustrious Lineage'...!?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
“...T-Then, look! Wouldn't you please try 
this hamburger steak... after all?!”

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Would you be willing to tell me the 
reason?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
A young lady like you must have a refined 
palate. I'd love your stamp of approval!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Packed with the pride of the shopping 
district, the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"— It's guaranteed to win over 
anyone's stomach!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
choice_data_list: ...Ruby, what do you want to do?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"...If all you require is for me to have 
some and share my impressions... then by 
all means."

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
! Yes, that works for me! Thank you so 
much...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Returning to the academy, I eat the cooked 
hamburger steak together with Daiichi 
Ruby...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby's expression remained 
unchanged. My heart pounded as I watched 
to see what she thought.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: H-How did it go...?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the meal. —It was 
exquisitely delicious.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: !!!! ALRIIIIIGHT--!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems the folks from the shopping 
district had been watching anxiously with 
bated breath... as sudden cheers and 
applause broke out.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you won something great! Our carrots 
are super delicious~!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
You're a Tracen Academy girl, so you must 
love carrots too, right?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
It contains a lot of nutrients, so I make 
a conscious effort to consume it actively.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: ...Um, does that mean you like it?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see! Well then, dig in and enjoy 
every last bite!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"...If you are at a loss as to what to do 
with it, I do have an idea."
choice_data_list: I'd like to leave it to you.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Understood.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Please arrange for these carrots to be 
delivered to the Tracen Academy cafeteria.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Could I borrow a pen and paper as well?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days later—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, look! It says all-you-can-eat carrot 
salad again today! I'm so happy~!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Rumor has it, a note in wonderfully 
elegant handwriting was delivered to the 
cafeteria saying 'A donation.' It must be 
from a wonderful gentleman!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...I shall take my lunch as well, so 
please excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Sorry there's only one skewer. Make sure 
you enjoy it, alright!
choice_data_list: By the way, what about Ruby...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your concern. Please go 
ahead and enjoy it yourself, Trainer.
choice_data_list: I wonder if it turned out tasty...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I know my own cooking skills. Even if I 
tried cooking for myself, it wouldn't turn 
out impressively delicious.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...Cooking carrots in oil enhances the 
absorption rate of beta-carotene.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
You must be done with your business now. 
Let us return to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Back in the room, I cooked the carrots in 
oil just as Daiichi Ruby instructed. 
Taking a bite, a gentle sweetness spread 
across my tongue.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Daiichi Ruby's advice, the 
nutritional value should be a bit higher. 
I felt like... I somehow got a little more 
energized.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: A participation prize...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, these things happen! I'll be 
waiting for your next challenge!
choice_data_list: I know, let's go shopping again...!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...Pardon me, but please refrain from 
making an unsightly scene.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
The result is what it is. It would be best 
to simply accept it gracefully.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
If there is something you desire that 
badly, do not leave it to luck—seize it 
with your own abilities.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: Sorry about this from me too...
